note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the clause is a placeholder, never real contract text; times are fictional labels. "Clause linked" and "external text" are supplied, neutral configurations of equal weight: they only say where the supplied scenario shows the clause slip (in the contract set's dock, or in the auxiliary document's dock). No incorporation rule, no conclusion that the clause is or is not part of anything and no jurisdiction is stated.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional facts, the story's end state; the lens enlarges the clause station; its label "Slip in set B (as supplied)" is substituted by the supplied alternative "Slip in document A (as supplied)"; the clause slip leaves the contract set's dock for the auxiliary document's own and the headline follows the configuration (clause linked → external text, as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: other fictional parties, documents and clause; the substitution runs the other way — the slip in the price list becomes the slip in the order set, as supplied (external text → clause linked).
